notes: Match is now part of the main window. Click Match and the scope becomes a drop zone: drop one reference hit on it (an audio file, or a hit your DAW lets you drag out as a file) or click it to choose a file. While the search runs, the wave of the reference fills with colour, with the stage, the percentage and the time. The answers come as a list: each shows what it explains in all, in the body and in the top, and has buttons Play, Apply, Top / Body (the same samples with the levels fitted the other way, to compare in two clicks) and i (the samples with their levels). The Phase and Spectrum views of the scope show the answer you have put into the mixer against the reference. Apply brings the mixer back.
